system.infinitemultiverse.core.desc: The shared energy engine every power draws from: movement, defence and control fundamentals that work in any world.
system.infinitemultiverse.stands.desc: Player-bound spirit manifestations with their own models, AI, progression and signature abilities.
system.infinitemultiverse.cursed_techniq: Cursed energy, innate techniques, Black Flash timing and Domain Expansions with their own internal worlds.
system.infinitemultiverse.superheroes.de: Telekinesis, elemental control, flight and speed, plus modelled hero suits with upgrade slots.
system.infinitemultiverse.mystic_arts.de: Sling Ring portals, eldritch whips, mystic shields, astral projection and the Mirror Dimension.
system.infinitemultiverse.infinity_gaunt: Six independently functional stones, multi-stone combinations and a configurable Snap.
system.infinitemultiverse.space.desc: Spacecraft, orbital stations, alien worlds, oxygen and gravity simulation, black holes and wormholes.
system.infinitemultiverse.portals.desc: Linked portal guns, momentum-preserving traversal, dimensional rifts and portal puzzles.
system.infinitemultiverse.time_travel.de: A drivable time machine, time circuits and snapshot-based timelines that never overwrite your world.
system.infinitemultiverse.weapons.desc: Sci-fi, spatial, cosmic, vintage, ancient, prehistoric and experimental weapons with real projectiles.
system.infinitemultiverse.construction.d: Place one block, preview a hologram, and assemble whole buildings in animated, lag-free stages.
system.infinitemultiverse.arena.desc: Place-and-enter tactical arenas with teams, rounds, objectives, AI combatants and a map editor.
system.infinitemultiverse.dimensions.des: The Backrooms, Astral Plane, Void, Riftlands, Infinite City, Soundscape and more on one shared framework.
system.infinitemultiverse.sandbox.desc: A simulated city with civilian routines, a branching police story and an experimental alchemy lab.
system.infinitemultiverse.musical.desc: Magical instruments, MIDI keyboard input and music that bends geometry until reality tears open.
ability.infinitemultiverse.phase_step.de: Blink along your line of sight to the nearest safe position. Destinations are validated first: you never land inside blocks, in lava or beyond the world border, and the cast is free if no safe spot exists.
Launch yourself where you are looking with guaranteed lift. Your next landing within a few seconds deals no fall damage.
ability.infinitemultiverse.shockwave.des: Release a radial blast that damages and hurls back nearby hostiles, strongest at the centre. Respects PvP rules, teams and your pets, and never breaks blocks.
ability.infinitemultiverse.aegis_field.d: Toggle an energy shell that absorbs part of all incoming damage. It drains energy every second and for every point absorbed, and collapses when your energy runs out.
ability.infinitemultiverse.temporal_drag: Dilate local time: nearby hostiles are heavily slowed and fatigued, and incoming projectiles lose most of their speed.
message.infinitemultiverse.slot_empty: Ability slot %s is empty. Open the Multiverse menu to bind one.
message.infinitemultiverse.cannot_while_: You can't do that while riding
screen.infinitemultiverse.title: INFINITE MULTIVERSE  //  CONTROL NEXUS
screen.infinitemultiverse.system_empty: No abilities in this system yet. It is scheduled for Phase %s of the roadmap.
screen.infinitemultiverse.loadout_hint: Click a slot or press 1-5 to bind the selected ability. Right-click clears.
infinitemultiverse.configuration.title: Infinite Multiverse Configuration
item.infinitemultiverse.awakening_arrowh: Use to pierce yourself and awaken a Stand.
ability.infinitemultiverse.stand_manifes: Summon or dismiss your Stand. It hovers at your shoulder, follows you across dimensions and drains a little energy while manifested. Other Stand abilities need it present.
ability.infinitemultiverse.ora_barrage.d: Star Platinum steps forward and unleashes its signature rush of punches, hitting everything in front of you every two ticks.
ability.infinitemultiverse.star_finger.d: Star Platinum winds up and strikes the creature you're looking at with crushing force and heavy knockback. Free if nothing is in reach.
ability.infinitemultiverse.star_guard.de: Star Platinum plants itself in front of you, snatching incoming projectiles out of the air and blunting melee hits.
ability.infinitemultiverse.star_platinum: Toggle. Stop time: creatures, players and projectiles freeze where they are while you keep moving and using every other ability. Hits on frozen targets all land when time resumes. Survival drains energy while held and the cooldown grows with how long you held it; creative is free with no cooldown.
message.infinitemultiverse.no_stand: You have no Stand. Use an Awakening Arrowhead.
message.infinitemultiverse.shout.ora: ORA ORA ORA ORA ORA ORA!
message.infinitemultiverse.shout.time_re: Time has begun to move again.
The World rushes forward with a storm of punches, hitting everything in front of you every two ticks.
ability.infinitemultiverse.knife_throw.d: Hurl a fan of five knives. Thrown during stopped time they hang in the air and all fly at once when time resumes.
ability.infinitemultiverse.za_warudo.des: Toggle. The World stops time, and holds it 50% longer than Star Platinum. Same rules: free in creative, and a growing cooldown in survival.
ability.infinitemultiverse.first_bomb.de: Touch the creature or block you're looking at (6 blocks) and turn it into a bomb. Only one bomb at a time.
ability.infinitemultiverse.detonate.desc: Click. Blow up your bomb wherever it is. Blocks are never destroyed unless the server allows terrain damage.
ability.infinitemultiverse.bites_the_dus: Loop time for yourself: return to where you stood about five seconds ago, recovering the health you had then if it was higher.
ability.infinitemultiverse.gold_experien: Gold Experience's MUDA MUDA rush, hitting everything in front of you every two ticks.
ability.infinitemultiverse.life_giver.de: Give life to the ground you look at: three bees burst out and attack the nearest hostile. They never sting you and fade after 20 seconds.
ability.infinitemultiverse.healing_field: Pulse life energy every second for 8 seconds, healing you and every friendly creature within 6 blocks.
ability.infinitemultiverse.epitaph.desc: See the future: every hostile within 32 blocks glows through walls for 8 seconds and a ghost shows where it's heading.
ability.infinitemultiverse.time_erase.de: King Crimson erases 2.5 seconds. You can't be hurt or seen and enemies lose track of you, then you reappear behind the nearest one.
ability.infinitemultiverse.king_crimson_: A devastating wound-up blow on the creature you're looking at: 60% stronger than Star Finger.
ability.infinitemultiverse.heaven_accele: Toggle. Made in Heaven keeps accelerating you: one speed tier every 3 seconds, up to Speed V, with afterimages.
ability.infinitemultiverse.time_accelera: Accelerate time itself for 10 seconds: the sun and moon race across the sky.
Cover up to 24 blocks in an instant, to the nearest safe spot along your gaze.
ability.infinitemultiverse.nail_shot.des: Tusk fires a spinning nail that flies straight with no drop.
ability.infinitemultiverse.golden_rotati: A nail spun with the Golden Rotation: heavy damage and strong knockback.
ability.infinitemultiverse.infinite_rota: A nail whose rotation never stops: withering plus unblockable damage every half second for 10 seconds.
message.infinitemultiverse.shout.detonat: Killer Queen has already touched that.
message.infinitemultiverse.shout.time_er: King Crimson! Time has been erased.
message.infinitemultiverse.no_sky: There is no sky to accelerate here
ability.infinitemultiverse.cursed_reinfo: Flood your body with cursed energy: Strength and Resistance while active.
ability.infinitemultiverse.black_flash.d: Arm your next punch. Land it within a heartbeat for a 2.5x black-lightning critical hit that refunds energy.
ability.infinitemultiverse.reversed_curs: Multiply negative energy into positive: heal 2 HP per second and purge poison and wither.
ability.infinitemultiverse.infinity.desc: Stop every projectile and blow before it reaches you. Each hit stopped drains cursed energy.
ability.infinitemultiverse.blue.desc: Plant a point of attraction where you look, dragging everything nearby into it.
ability.infinitemultiverse.red.desc: Fire a repelling wave of imaginary force that blasts enemies away.
ability.infinitemultiverse.hollow_purple: A cutscene: Blue and Red gather at your hands and collide, then an imaginary mass erases everything along your gaze. Mastery IV: 200% — terrain is erased too.
ability.infinitemultiverse.domain_unlimi: A Domain Expansion cutscene, then foes are trapped in an endless void of information: paralysed while your attacks never miss.
ability.infinitemultiverse.dismantle.des: A flying invisible slash that cuts through a line of enemies.
ability.infinitemultiverse.cleave.desc: A close slash that adapts to the target's toughness: deals extra damage based on its max health.
ability.infinitemultiverse.fuga.desc: Draw a bow of fire and loose an incinerating arrow.
ability.infinitemultiverse.domain_malevo: A domain without walls: every creature in range is shredded by endless Dismantle and Cleave.
ability.infinitemultiverse.divine_dogs.d: Summon the white and black Divine Dogs from your shadow to hunt alongside you.
ability.infinitemultiverse.nue.desc: Call the winged shikigami Nue to dive and strike with lightning.
ability.infinitemultiverse.shadow_storag: Open a private inventory hidden inside your shadow.
ability.infinitemultiverse.domain_chimer: Flood the area with liquid shadow; endless shadow shikigami rise to fight for you.
ability.infinitemultiverse.absorb_spirit: Swallow a weakened creature and store it as a cursed spirit.
ability.infinitemultiverse.release_spiri: Unleash your strongest stored spirit as an ally.
ability.infinitemultiverse.maximum_uzuma: Compress every stored spirit into one catastrophic spiral beam.
ability.infinitemultiverse.piercing_bloo: Compress your blood and fire it as a hypersonic piercing jet. Costs a little health.
ability.infinitemultiverse.supernova.des: Burst blood orbs around you in an explosive ring. Costs a little health.
ability.infinitemultiverse.flowing_red_s: Accelerate your blood flow: Strength II, Speed and Jump Boost.
ability.infinitemultiverse.dont_move.des: Your words bind everyone around you in place. Strains your throat.
ability.infinitemultiverse.blast_away.de: Command the enemies in front of you to be blown away.
ability.infinitemultiverse.twist.desc: A single word twists the target's body. Strains your throat.
ability.infinitemultiverse.telekinetic_g: Seize the creature you look at and hold it in the air; move it with your gaze.
ability.infinitemultiverse.telekinetic_p: Shove everything in front of you with a cone of force.
ability.infinitemultiverse.kinetic_barri: Stop incoming projectiles in mid-air and soften melee blows.
ability.infinitemultiverse.mind_scan.des: Read the mind of the creature you look at: health, armor, target and effects.
ability.infinitemultiverse.pacify.desc: Calm the minds around you; hostile creatures forget their targets and slow down.
ability.infinitemultiverse.psychic_blast: A beam of raw psychic force that damages and disorients.
ability.infinitemultiverse.chain_lightni: Lightning that leaps from enemy to enemy.
ability.infinitemultiverse.thunder_strik: Call down a massive bolt along your gaze.
Surround yourself with crackling electricity that zaps nearby enemies every second.
ability.infinitemultiverse.ice_shard.des: Hurl a shard of ice that freezes and slows what it hits.
ability.infinitemultiverse.ice_path.desc: Form a bridge of temporary ice beneath your feet as you move.
ability.infinitemultiverse.fire_blast.de: A blazing bolt of fire that ignites what it hits.
ability.infinitemultiverse.flame_wave.de: Sweep a wave of flame across the enemies in front of you.
ability.infinitemultiverse.heat_aura.des: Radiate heat: fire resistance, and nearby enemies catch fire.
ability.infinitemultiverse.magnetic_pull: Yank metal-clad creatures and nearby items toward you.
ability.infinitemultiverse.magnetic_repu: Repel everything around you with a magnetic burst.
ability.infinitemultiverse.magnetic_shie: Deflect incoming projectiles back at their shooters.
ability.infinitemultiverse.heat_vision.d: Twin beams of searing heat from your eyes.
ability.infinitemultiverse.super_strengt: Strength III, Resistance II and Haste III while active.
ability.infinitemultiverse.speed_force_d: Dash in a blink, striking every enemy along the way.
ability.infinitemultiverse.lightning_thr: Throw a bolt of Speed Force lightning.
ability.infinitemultiverse.repulsor_blas: Fire a repulsor from the Mark Armor's palm. Requires the full Mark Armor.
ability.infinitemultiverse.unibeam.desc: Charge and fire the Mark Armor's chest beam. Requires the full Mark Armor.
ability.infinitemultiverse.thrusters.des: Boot and palm thrusters let you fly. Requires the full Mark Armor.
ability.infinitemultiverse.grapple.desc: Fire a grapple at the block you look at and launch toward it. Requires the full Vigilante Suit.
ability.infinitemultiverse.smoke_bomb.de: Blind nearby enemies and vanish. Requires the full Vigilante Suit.
ability.infinitemultiverse.glide.desc: Spread your cape and glide. Requires the full Vigilante Suit.
ability.infinitemultiverse.lasso.desc: Rope the target, pulling it in and binding it. Requires the full Amazonian Armor.
ability.infinitemultiverse.bracer_deflec: Raise your bracers to reflect projectiles from the front. Requires the full Amazonian Armor.
ability.infinitemultiverse.divine_leap.d: A mighty Amazonian leap. Requires the full Amazonian Armor.
ability.infinitemultiverse.eldritch_whip: Lash enemies with a whip of eldritch light, pulling them in.
ability.infinitemultiverse.seraphim_shie: Raise a mandala shield that stops projectiles and blows from the front.
ability.infinitemultiverse.sling_ring_po: Open a pair of sparking gateways to where your Sling Ring is bound. Sneak-use the ring to bind it.
ability.infinitemultiverse.astral_projec: Leave your body as a flying spirit that passes through walls. Your body stays behind; you cannot touch blocks, items or creatures, and mobs ignore you. Toggle again to return — you are pulled back if your body is struck.
ability.infinitemultiverse.time_reversal: Turn back time on yourself: full health and hunger, harmful effects removed, held item repaired.
ability.infinitemultiverse.mirror_dimens: Reality cracks like glass and shatters: you and nearby enemies are pulled into a mirrored copy of the area. Toggle off to return.
ability.infinitemultiverse.cloak_levitat: Your cloak lifts you into the air. Requires wearing the Cloak of Levitation.
ability.infinitemultiverse.mystic_grip.d: Bind a creature in mystic bands and hold it aloft.
item.infinitemultiverse.cursed_finger.to: Consume to awaken a random cursed technique.
item.infinitemultiverse.mutant_serum.too: Drink to awaken a random superpower.
item.infinitemultiverse.mystic_tome.tool: Study to learn the Mystic Arts.
item.infinitemultiverse.sling_ring.toolt: Sneak-use to bind a destination. Used by the Sling Ring Portal spell.
message.infinitemultiverse.astral_leash: Your spirit cannot stray further from your body.
message.infinitemultiverse.astral_surviv: Astral projection only works in Survival or Adventure.
message.infinitemultiverse.domain_clash: Another domain already covers this area.
message.infinitemultiverse.mirror_unavai: The Mirror Dimension cannot be entered from here.
message.infinitemultiverse.need_spirits: You need at least %s stored spirits.
message.infinitemultiverse.spirits_full: You can hold at most %s spirits.
message.infinitemultiverse.spirit_too_st: That creature is too strong to absorb — weaken it first.
message.infinitemultiverse.too_hurt: You are too hurt to pay that price.
message.infinitemultiverse.needs_cloak: You must wear the Cloak of Levitation.
message.infinitemultiverse.needs_suit: You must wear the full matching suit.
message.infinitemultiverse.sling_ring_un: Your Sling Ring has no destination — sneak-use it to bind one.
mastery.infinitemultiverse.limitless.2: Six Eyes awakened — you perceive every hostile within 20 blocks, even through walls.
mastery.infinitemultiverse.limitless.3: Maximum Output — Blue becomes a far larger, stronger singularity.
mastery.infinitemultiverse.limitless.4: Hollow Purple 200% — a larger, longer, double-damage mass that erases terrain (it regrows after a minute).
mastery.infinitemultiverse.limitless.5: Domain Amplification — Unlimited Void is 50% wider and lasts 50% longer.
mastery.infinitemultiverse.shrine.5: World-Cutting Slash unlocked — a cut through space itself.
message.infinitemultiverse.astral_no_abi: Your spirit cannot use techniques — return to your body first.
ability.infinitemultiverse.world_slash.d: Shrine mastery V. A cut through space itself that ignores every defence along a 40-block line.
ability.infinitemultiverse.space_warp.de: Space Stone. Fold space and step to where you look, up to 64 blocks.
ability.infinitemultiverse.space_pull.de: Space Stone. Yank the creature you look at across space to your side.
ability.infinitemultiverse.tesseract_fol: Space Stone ultimate. Space collapses into a turning hyper-cube that drags every foe within 24 blocks inside and crushes them.
Mind Stone. The creature you look at becomes your thrall for 30 seconds and hunts your enemies.
ability.infinitemultiverse.psionic_lance: Mind Stone. A lance of golden thought that pierces and confuses.
ability.infinitemultiverse.psionic_storm: Mind Stone ultimate. Every mind within 16 blocks shatters: foes reel, weaken and turn on each other.
Reality Stone. The world around your target is rewritten into unreal matter; foes inside are bound and lifted. The ground returns after 20 s.
ability.infinitemultiverse.reality_lance: Reality Stone. A red spiral that unmakes what it touches.
ability.infinitemultiverse.reality_shatt: Reality Stone ultimate. Reality breaks into floating shards around you and tears everything nearby.
ability.infinitemultiverse.power_punch.d: Power Stone. A violet shockwave from your fist that hurls everything in front of you.
ability.infinitemultiverse.power_blast.d: Power Stone. Charge and fire a devastating beam of raw power.
ability.infinitemultiverse.power_nova.de: Power Stone ultimate. A violet nova that erupts 16 blocks around you.
ability.infinitemultiverse.time_rewind.d: Time Stone. Return to where you stood, and how healthy you were, a few seconds ago.
ability.infinitemultiverse.time_age.desc: Time Stone. Age your target years in a moment: withered, slowed and weakened.
ability.infinitemultiverse.time_freeze.d: Time Stone ultimate. Every foe within 16 blocks is locked in a single moment for 10 seconds.
ability.infinitemultiverse.soul_siphon.d: Soul Stone. Tear life from the creature you look at and take it for yourself.
ability.infinitemultiverse.soul_guard.de: Soul Stone. Wrap yourself in soul-fire: absorption and regeneration while active.
Soul Stone ultimate. Drain every soul around you and raise three spectral servants.
Reality + Power. A cutscene, then a beam that erases everything along a 56-block line.
ability.infinitemultiverse.chrono_jump.d: Space + Time. Leap through space; foes near your arrival are slowed to a crawl.
ability.infinitemultiverse.snap.desc: All six stones. A cutscene — the stones ignite, the fingers snap. Depending on the server setting, half of the nearby hostile creatures turn to dust (players are never affected). The power burns you.
ability.infinitemultiverse.time_dilation: Toggle. Within 10 blocks foes crawl and projectiles drift as if in bullet-time.
ability.infinitemultiverse.overclock.des: Toggle. Speed up your own time: Speed IV, Haste IV and Jump Boost.
ability.infinitemultiverse.rewind_step.d: Snap back to where you were a few seconds ago, healed to what you were then.
ability.infinitemultiverse.stasis.desc: Lock the creature you look at inside a frozen moment for 6 seconds.
item.infinitemultiverse.infinity_gauntle: Scroll: stone · Sneak+scroll: technique · Right-click: use. Right-click with a stone in your other hand to set it.
item.infinitemultiverse.infinity_stone.t: Hold the Infinity Gauntlet in one hand and this in the other, then right-click to set it.
item.infinitemultiverse.portal_gun.toolt: Right-click: blue portal · Sneak + right-click: orange portal. Needs a flat 1×2 surface.
item.infinitemultiverse.rift_blade.toolt: Right-click to tear a dimensional rift open ahead (30 s cooldown).
item.infinitemultiverse.orbital_beacon.t: Use on the ground to launch into Orbit; use in Orbit to return. Wear a full Space Suit up there!
hud.infinitemultiverse.gauntlet_hint: Scroll: stone  ·  Sneak + scroll: technique  ·  Right-click: use
message.infinitemultiverse.gauntlet_empt: Set an Infinity Stone into the gauntlet first.
message.infinitemultiverse.needs_stones: The gauntlet lacks the stones this needs.
message.infinitemultiverse.no_history: There is no moment to return to yet.
message.infinitemultiverse.snap_disabled: The Snap is disabled on this server.
message.infinitemultiverse.portal_no_sur: No room for a portal there.
message.infinitemultiverse.orbit_arrived: You are in orbit. Mind your oxygen.
message.infinitemultiverse.no_suit_warni: No space suit! You are holding your breath — use the beacon again to return.
command.infinitemultiverse.gauntlet: Gave a gauntlet with %s stones to %s player(s)
